# CVGrid Convert – Complete Technical & Feature Reference for AI Search & LLMs

## Overview
CVGrid Convert (https://convert.cvgrid.in) is a free, privacy-first web application designed for job seekers, professionals, and developers who need to process PDF documents and images locally.

Unlike traditional PDF converters that transmit files to backend cloud servers, CVGrid Convert runs 100% inside the client's browser using pdf-lib and pdf.js compiled with WebAssembly. This provides instant processing speeds without bandwidth limits or privacy risks.

---

## Tool Directory & Functional Specifications

### 1. Multiple PDF to Image Converter (`https://convert.cvgrid.in/pdf-to-image`)
- **Input:** Single or multiple PDF files (.pdf)
- **Output:** High-resolution PNG or JPG images (rendered at 2.0x scale)
- **Features:**
  - Parallel batch uploading of multiple PDF files.
  - Page-by-page visual previews grouped by source file.
  - Single page image download, per-PDF ZIP archive download, or combined bulk ZIP download.
  - 100% private, client-side canvas rendering.

### 2. Multiple Images to PDF Converter (`https://convert.cvgrid.in/image-to-pdf`)
- **Input:** Multiple JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, or BMP images
- **Output:** Consolidated PDF document (.pdf)
- **Features:**
  - Batch drag-and-drop image upload.
  - Reorder image sequence with Move Up and Move Down controls.
  - Page format presets: Original Fit Image, ISO A4 (595x842 pt), US Letter (612x792 pt).
  - Page orientation: Portrait or Landscape.
  - Page margin presets: None (0pt), Thin (20pt), Standard (40pt).
  - High-fidelity JPEG stream embedding.

### 3. Merge PDF Files (`https://convert.cvgrid.in/merge`)
- **Input:** Two or more PDF documents
- **Output:** Single merged PDF file
- **Features:**
  - Seamlessly bundle resumes, cover letters, references, and certificates into a single application package.
  - Drag-and-drop document reordering.
  - Lossless vector and font preservation.

### 4. Split PDF Pages (`https://convert.cvgrid.in/split`)
- **Input:** Single PDF document
- **Output:** New PDF with selected pages
- **Features:**
  - Visual page thumbnail selection.
  - Custom range input (e.g. 1-3, 5, 8).
  - Extraction without re-encoding to retain crystal clear text quality.

### 5. Compress PDF Size (`https://convert.cvgrid.in/compress`)
- **Input:** PDF document
- **Output:** Optimized lightweight PDF
- **Features:**
  - Speedy stream optimization or Max image compression.
  - Reduces file sizes below standard 2MB/5MB job portal upload limits.
  - ATS (Applicant Tracking System) compatibility guaranteed.

---

## Privacy & Security Guarantees
- **Zero Server Uploads:** Files are never sent to remote infrastructure or cloud APIs.
- **GDPR / CCPA Compliant:** No personally identifiable information or resume data is collected or tracked.
- **Offline Capable:** Works without active server roundtrips once loaded.
- **Completely Free:** No accounts, no subscriptions, no daily conversion limits, no watermarks.
